findings.alternative: Natsuhi also blames herself later, and Beatrice consoles her throughout, but WH relocates this initial criticism from other people’s treatment of her to her own self-accusation.

contexts.japanesePS3: どこまで我が物にならぬというのか！！

findings.sourceReading: どこまで我が物にならぬというのか angrily asks to what lengths the addressed entity will go in not becoming his, continuing the struggle question and preceding rejection of an empty cage.
findings.alternative: How long before you are mine can imply frustrated resistance, but WH presumes eventual possession where the source explicitly emphasizes refusal or continuing non-possession. The unspecified addressee is not identified by this finding.
